content.text: {"id": "mm5905a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "In 2008, 75% of all U.S. children aged <6 years (approximately 18 million children) participated in an IIS."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Of the 52 responding grantees, 22 grantees (42%) reported that >95% of children aged <6 years participated in the IIS"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Nationally, 95 million persons of all ages (33% of the U.S. population) were participating in an IIS in 2008."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "compared with 15 million (65%) in 2006"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "To monitor progress toward this goal, CDC annually surveys immunization grantees"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "From 2006 to 2008, participation increased from 65% to 75%."}]}, {"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The 2008 IISAR, a self-administered, Internet-based questionnaire"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "was calculated by dividing the number of children aged <6 years participating in the IIS by the 2008 mid-year U.S. Census projection"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "to determine the proportion that are >90% complete in IIS records."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Calculated by number of data field completions in IIS records and the overall number of IIS records."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
